periodEpisode.label: Period episode
periodEpisode.definition: A user-controlled menstrual period record with a start time, an optional end time while open, and provenance.

flow.label: Menstrual flow
flow.definition: A recorded flow observation using the canonical levels spotting, light, medium, or heavy.

observationKind.label: Health observation kind
observationKind.definition: The canonical cross-platform category assigned to a locally recorded health or wellbeing observation.

lifeStage.label: Life stage
lifeStage.definition: The user-selected Sreadya mode that adapts relevant product behaviour while preserving historical cycle records.

predictionConfidence.label: Prediction confidence
predictionConfidence.definition: A low, medium, or high evidence label produced by prediction-v1 from available cycle-history consistency; it is not a guarantee.

reminderPrivacy.label: Reminder privacy
reminderPrivacy.definition: The amount of health detail allowed in reminder text: maximum, balanced, or detailed.

accountFreeMode.label: Account-free mode
accountFreeMode.definition: The first-class Sreadya mode in which core health functionality works locally without creating or requiring an online account.

accountMode.label: Account mode
accountMode.definition: An optional identity mode that may add encrypted cross-device continuity without making core health functionality superior to account-free mode.

encryptedSync.label: Encrypted sync
encryptedSync.definition: Optional cross-device continuity in which reproductive-health content is encrypted on clients and the service is designed to handle ciphertext plus minimum operational metadata only.

trustedDevice.label: Trusted device
trustedDevice.definition: A device explicitly authorized under the future reviewed continuity protocol to participate in the user's encrypted Sreadya vault.

recoveryKey.label: Recovery key
recoveryKey.definition: A user-controlled recovery secret defined by the reviewed continuity protocol; email or phone identity alone must not decrypt historical vault contents.
